subject: design/worktracker-hierarchy-index
statement: Carina gains a parent→children query exposed as a **parent filter on the existing `list`** (composing with the state/signal/role filters) plus an **all-states `show <epic>` rollup** grouped by open/closed — one implementation shared by the port and the CLI, over the existing `Children` port method, adding no new port verb (`design-brainstorm:worktracker-hierarchy-query-tech-design#D-1`). It is backed by a **reverse-parent directory** — one **empty marker file per edge** under a parent-keyed directory (`design-brainstorm:worktracker-hierarchy-query-tech-design#D-3` · `#ALT-1`) — that is **derived, non-authoritative, gitignored, and rebuildable** (`#D-4`): git versions only the authoritative item files. The index is maintained **incrementally** at the single edge-mutation choke point (one marker created/removed per parent-write, the item written first) and **healed by a full `reindex` rebuild** — the sole drift-recovery, cheap enough at the store's capacity to be the only one (`#D-5`, benchmark-backed). The child's `parent` field remains the sole truth; the index only accelerates *which files to open*, never *what they say*, so a read that feeds a destructive or dispatch decision re-verifies each candidate's own `parent` field — O(k) reads never cost consistency.
